partner_results_applied.actual_use: M=2B, literal private original scalar W; yields 4sqrt(2)/sqrt(|a|sigma_1(B)) while retaining arbitrary G(Y) and rho(Y)W

proved_this_run: One-sided-curvature all-rank cross/private-square fusion: for T=2X^TBY+alpha^TX+G(Y)+aW^2+rho(Y)W+c with disjoint original product banks, density <= min_j C_j(B) and <=4sqrt(2)/sqrt(|a|sigma_1(B)).
Ambient original-coordinate block [[0,B,0],[B^T,C,h],[0,h^T,a]] permits arbitrary C,h and arbitrary outside couplings after original-coordinate conditioning.
Exact target family Q_{r,t,C,d}=U_+^2-U_-^2+2(t/sqrt(r))sum X_iY_i+Y^TCY+(sqrt(r)/t)W^2+2(d^TY)W has density <=4sqrt(2) for all r>=2,t>0, arbitrary C,d, and all cap-one product laws.

The explicit target family has a C_0 representative by convolving its L1-cap-Linf active density with the L1 law of U_+^2-U_-^2; no continuity of the rank-two opposite-sign component itself is assumed.
